## Computer Use v1.0.0

本版将内置 Cua Driver 与 Node SDK 同步升级到 0.47.8，并更新 macOS、Windows 的应用图标。

- **桌面驱动**：包含上游累计的 macOS 窗口查找、截图和辅助功能读取优化，以及 Windows 输入尾字和焦点恢复修复。驱动和 SDK 使用同一固定版本，三平台内置组件在 CI 中核对架构、版本和校验和。
- **动作反馈**：驱动明确报告控件已禁用且没有派发输入时，运行时返回确定的拒绝；缺少该证据时仍保留结果未知。
- **应用图标**：采用圆润的亮冰青指针与青紫柔光。Windows EXE、窗口、安装器和正常托盘使用同一图标；macOS Dock 增加透明留白，菜单栏使用由系统着色的同一指针轮廓。
- **验证范围**：发布包由 CI 构建、校验并上传。打包检查不代表在每种桌面应用、键盘布局或 Windows 10 上实测了截图与输入。

完整上游变化见 [Cua Driver 变更日志](https://github.com/trycua/cua/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.47.8/libs/cua-driver/rust/CHANGELOG.md)。

### English

- Pins the bundled Cua Driver and Node SDK to 0.47.8 on macOS and Windows, including upstream window observation and input fixes.
- Reports a disabled control as a definite refusal only when the driver confirms that no input was sent.
- Refreshes the application and Windows tray artwork with a rounded cursor and soft aurora. The macOS Dock icon has more transparent padding, and the menu bar tints the same cursor contour for its background.
- CI builds, verifies, and publishes the packages. Package checks do not establish live desktop compatibility for every application, keyboard layout, or Windows 10 system.
